title: Bukidnon City council row erupts over 10% kickback allegations

blocks.text: MALAYBALAY CITY, Bukidnon — A dispute erupted on the floor of the Sangguniang Panlungsod (SP) here during its regular session on Tuesday, following allegations that several barangay captains demanded a 10 percent “Standard Operating Procedure” (SOP), also known as kickbacks, from contractors implementing city infrastructure projects in their villages. In a privilege speech, Ex-Officio Councilor and Liga ng mga Barangay president Julius Manghano criticized the claims, calling the broad accusations unfair, generalized, and damaging to the reputation of all 46 barangay captains in Malaybalay City. Manghano specifically targeted social media posts by fellow Councilor Jason Chad Ayala, who had publicly invited […]...
